name: Landing Start Demo
description: The guided entry journey from the landing page through the board, platform guides, and the prepared Golden Initiative flow.

steps.title: Understand the board at a glance
steps.text: These cards summarize the Jira work items, workflow statuses, connected project, and live board source.

steps.title: Explore the initiative board
steps.text: The board brings synthetic Jira work items into one view so you can see where initiatives are in the governed journey.

steps.title: Ask Ciel for explanations
steps.text: Ciel can explain the current initiative, evidence, and decision context. Ciel assists and drafts; authorized people remain responsible for decisions.

steps.title: What Initiatives is for
steps.text: Product Owners use this page to capture business context, accountable ownership, scope, risk context, and success criteria before creating a Jira initiative. We are only exploring the page for now.

steps.title: Find other guided demos
steps.text: The Guided demos page contains focused tours for the general workbench and the prepared Golden Initiative flow. You can return here whenever you want another walkthrough.

steps.title: Experiment safely in Sandbox
steps.text: The Sandbox link opens a separate experimentation area for synthetic Jira searches and bounded scenarios. It is designed for safe tests, not production decisions.

steps.title: Find useful platform information
steps.text: Help center contains plain-language guides for evidence and lineage, risk and controls, human decisions, Jira integration, Ciel and AI, Sandbox usage, and guided demos.

steps.title: Begin the prepared Golden Initiative flow
steps.text: Load the synthetic remittance example so you can review the context and accountable owner. Nothing is created until the later confirmation step.

steps.title: Create it under Maya Chen
steps.text: The Golden Initiative is prepared with Maya Chen as the accountable Product Owner. Select Create initiative to open the final confirmation checkpoint.

steps.title: Confirm and create the Jira initiative
steps.text: Review the synthetic story and owner, then confirm. This is the authorized write that creates the Jira item.

steps.title: Confirm the Jira creation
steps.text: This status confirms the initiative was created in Jira and provides a link to open it there. We will continue in the FULCRUM view for the guided assessment.

steps.title: Continue in FULCRUM
steps.text: Open the newly created item in FULCRUM. The work item remains connected to Jira, while FULCRUM provides the governed evaluation workspace.

steps.title: Review the initiative context
steps.text: Scroll through the created initiative to review its summary, owner, description, labels, Jira status, and supporting context before evaluating it.

steps.title: FULCRUM evaluation
steps.text: This panel assesses whether the Jira initiative is ready for the current workflow stage using deterministic checks and AI decision support.

steps.title: Start the evaluation
steps.text: Select Evaluate Intake. This may take a moment while FULCRUM reviews multiple factors with automated checks and AI-supported analysis.

steps.title: Read the summary scores
steps.text: These summary cards show the weighted score, the recommendation, and how many checks passed. The final recommendation is decision support, not an automatic approval.

steps.title: Scoring configuration
steps.text: The scoring configuration shows the proceed threshold, partial-credit rule, and AI-versus-automatic weighting. A Risk Officer can update these values in Configuration, and each evaluation keeps a snapshot of what was used.

steps.title: Understand the AI response
steps.text: The AI response summarizes its recommendation, challenge, benefits, trade-offs, rationale, and Jira context. It is an explainable observation for a human reviewer, not an authoritative decision.

steps.title: Review the evaluation metrics
steps.text: The metric circles below show how each configured check performed and, where available, how the automatic and AI views contributed to the check result.

steps.title: Know when FULCRUM suggests the next step
steps.text: The proceed threshold is the configured score at which FULCRUM suggests moving to the next workflow area. An authorized person still makes the final decision.

steps.title: Publish the evaluation to Jira
steps.text: Publish the completed evaluation to add the governed result to the Jira work item. This creates the durable assessment record and Jira collaboration comment.

steps.title: Re-evaluate when the result needs another look
steps.text: Use Re-evaluate if you are not satisfied with the score, if context has changed, or if you want to resolve the issues highlighted by the evaluation before moving forward.

steps.title: Comments stay connected to Jira
steps.text: The comments area is integrated with Jira. After the current user authorizes FULCRUM to access Jira, a comment is posted as an actual Jira comment on this initiative.

steps.title: Add a contextual comment
steps.text: A prepared synthetic comment is filled into the composer. Selecting Next will post it to the Jira initiative as a Fulcrum-bot review note; you do not need to click Post comment separately.

steps.title: Attachments provide supporting context
steps.text: Attachments give the evaluation additional initiative context. Uploading uses the current user's Jira authorization, just like posting a comment.

steps.title: Add the sample PDF
steps.text: Selecting Next will upload the Golden Initiative PDF as supporting context; you do not need to click Add sample PDF separately. You can replace this synthetic sample later with the proper document.

steps.title: Re-evaluate after adding context
steps.text: Run the evaluation again after the comment and attachment are present. This may take a moment while the updated Jira context is assessed.

steps.title: Publish the reevaluation
steps.text: Publish this updated evaluation to Jira so the new score, AI response, comment context, and configuration snapshot are recorded as the current version.

steps.title: Compare assessment versions
steps.text: Each published evaluation is retained as a version with its score, recommendation, and timestamp, so previous results can be compared rather than overwritten.

steps.title: Move to the next stage when ready
steps.text: When the published result meets the configured threshold and the work is fulfilled, FULCRUM suggests moving to the next stage. You still make the final decision to proceed.

steps.title: Reassign the next stage
steps.text: Every stage move opens this reassignment dialog so accountability is explicit. Choose Marcus Thompson for the next-stage owner, then confirm the assignment and transition.

name: Welcome Tour
description: A guided orientation to the workbench, decision lineage, risk controls, Jira context, and Ciel.

steps.title: Start with the dashboard
steps.text: Ask Ciel can explain the current workbench, while Welcome tour walks through the decision journey. Both actions stay inside the governed demo workspace.

steps.title: Live Jira board
steps.text: This board reflects the current synthetic FCRM work items and workflow status from Jira.

steps.title: At-a-glance context
steps.text: These summary cards show item volume, workflow coverage, the connected project, and whether the board is live.

steps.title: Formulate an initiative
steps.text: Product Owners start with a decision-ready business change. Capture the owner, outcome, scope, affected users, risk context, and success criteria before creating work in Jira.

steps.title: Find the deeper information in Help center
steps.text: The Help center contains focused guides for Evidence & lineage, Risk & controls, Human decisions, Jira integration, Ciel and AI, Sandbox usage, and Guided demos. Use those topics whenever you want the explanation behind a workspace feature.

steps.title: Ask Ciel
steps.text: Use Ciel, the FULCRUM AI Assistant, to explore the current initiative and decision context. Ciel explains and drafts; authorized humans decide.

name: Create the Golden Initiative
description: Walk through creating the synthetic Launch U.S.–Philippines Instant Remittance initiative from a prepared business context.

steps.title: Create a decision-ready initiative
steps.text: This guided flow uses the same formulation surface a Product Owner uses to prepare a new FCRM initiative. Nothing is written until you explicitly confirm it.

steps.title: Load the golden flow
steps.text: Click “Load Golden Initiative” to populate the synthetic Launch U.S.–Philippines Instant Remittance example. You can inspect or edit every field before continuing.

steps.title: Start with the business change
steps.text: The summary becomes the Jira work-item title. The golden flow describes a cross-border instant-remittance launch with a clear product and geographic change.

steps.title: Add governed context
steps.text: Review the problem, outcome, scope, affected users, risk considerations, and success criteria. These fields create the context FULCRUM evaluates later.

steps.title: Review the write action
steps.text: Choose “Create initiative” when the context is ready. The confirmation dialog is the final checkpoint before the Jira write.

steps.title: Confirm the synthetic write
steps.text: Confirm only when the story and accountable owner look right. The server-side Jira adapter creates the work item, assigns the owner, and verifies the Jira result.
